description: Lifetime of fleet VMs (fleet-recipe D12): the create arguments, the seconds sent in set_timeout (bounded by the platform cap) and the deadline held while an extra VM serves a request. Seconds in both SDKs; TypeScript multiplies by 1000.

createArgs.name: a single-VM fleet launches as in 0.16
min equal to max never has an extra VM
a fleet that can grow gets a logical deadline and a cap 60 s later
zero base VMs also scale in
a short serve timeout keeps the 120 s minimum cap
the cap never passes the 8 hour platform limit
a fractional serve timeout is rounded up first

lifetimeSeconds.name: unknown cap sends the desired value
unknown cap and no desired value sends nothing
near cap bounds to the cap minus 5 s
no desired value asks for everything up to the cap
a cap closer than the margin sends nothing
one second left is still sent

holdSeconds.name: a request longer than scale-in holds for the request
scale-in longer than the request holds for scale-in
no request timeout holds for scale-in
